about: W10.F7: a decision for every open PR whose head is not in the train (npm run train:missing). in = a task or train brings it; rejected = it will not go in, and why; replaced = what carries it instead. A decision is about one head: a PR that moves needs a new one.
note: Lane A1 (T8): every open PR whose head is not an ancestor of verify/train-7 @ 3100c18c43, decided again against that head (heads read from the GitHub REST API on 2026-11-16). Ports onto train 7 are #957-#983; the lane's evidence table is decisions.tsv in the lane's notes. Decisions about PRs now in the train or closed were dropped (train:missing ignores them).
